integrity: The universal proof is self-contained; the accompanying standard-library checker reproduces 23 exact finite comparisons and 22 normal-rank calculations. Claims of originality are qualified by the possibility of undiscovered equivalent literature.
scientific_limitations: Canonical zero-sum Euclidean realization, real scalars, at least two matched pairs, common pair distance strictly between zero and one. No assertion about unequal pair lengths, collapsed pairs, equilateral endpoint, or affine-invariant Banach--Mazur ellipsoids. Finite enumeration is corroboration, not proof.
title: Parity-controlled inball rigidity in matched-pair Lipschitz-free spaces
